**Severity:** error · **Area:** Config / plugin options (`RV7xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Invalid compiler option: {serde error}
```

```text
Invalid compiler option `styles`: expected an object `{ scope, names?, layer? }`
```

```text
Invalid compiler option `styles.scope`: expected a string
```

```text
Invalid compiler option `styles.names`: expected "readable" or "short"
```

```text
Invalid compiler option `styles.layer`: expected a string, null or false
```

```text
Invalid compiler option `resume.module`: expected a string
```

```text
Invalid compiler option `resume`: expected `{ module?: string }`, true or false
```

```text
Invalid compiler option `resume.model`: expected "serialized" or "derived"
```

```text
Invalid compiler option `resume.{key}`: expected an array of component names
```

```text
Invalid compiler option `targets`: unknown target "{bad}"
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Pass the option in the documented shape (e.g. resume: `{ module: "src/a.tsx" }` or true, resume.model: "serialized" or "derived", resume.boundaries / resume.independent: arrays of component names; styles: `{ scope: string }`).

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
check(src, { resume: 5 })
```

```tsx prefer
check(src, { resume: { module: "src/a.tsx" } })
```

## When it is reported

Integration error; no source range.
